"""RoboPaint lettering record. Uses only RGB/depth, proprioception and public robot APIs."""
import sys,json,time,os
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=Path('/app/output'); r=Robot()
Q=np.array([0.,1.,0.,0.])
def quat(angle=0):
 a=np.deg2rad(angle)/2
 return np.array([0,np.cos(a),np.sin(a),0.])
def obs(): return r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],depth=True)
def submit(a,note='',cams=['canvas_cam','practice_cam']):
 a=np.asarray(a); results=[]
 for i in range(0,len(a),180):
  chunk=a[i:i+180]
  stat=r.status(); idx=stat['calls']+1
  np.save(OUT/f'actions_{idx:04d}.npy',chunk)
  res=r.submit('ee_pose',chunk,dt=.05,cameras=cams,video='frames',video_fps=5,note=note)
  res.save(str(OUT/f'call_{idx:04d}'))
  for c,im in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT/f'{c}.png')
  print('call',idx,'steps',res.meta.get('control_steps'),'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),'pose',res.group('tcp_pose',now=True).tolist(),flush=True)
  if res.stopped or res.done: raise RuntimeError(res.meta)
  results.append(res)
 return results[-1]
def move(p,angle=0,speed=.04,hold=.3):
 o=r.get_obs(cameras=[]); old=o.group('tcp_pose',now=True); p=np.array(p)
 n=max(20,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(p-old[:3])/speed/.05)))
 # orientation stays or is interpolated by robot
 q=quat(angle)
 from scipy.spatial.transform import Slerp
 rot=Rotation.from_quat([np.roll(old[3:],-1),np.roll(q,-1)])
 qs=Slerp([0,1],rot)(np.linspace(0,1,n+1)[1:]).as_quat()
 a=np.c_[np.linspace(old[:3],p,n+1)[1:],np.roll(qs,1,axis=1)]
 a=np.vstack([a,np.tile(np.r_[p,q],(int(hold/.05),1))]);return submit(a,'move')
def line(points,angle=25,speed=.004,z=.0193):
 pts=np.asarray(points); rows=[]
 for a,b in zip(pts[:-1],pts[1:]):
  n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b-a)/speed/.05)))
  for p in np.linspace(a,b,n+1)[1:]: rows.append(np.r_[p,z,quat(angle)])
 return submit(rows,'practice line')
if __name__=='__main__':
 phase=sys.argv[1]
 if phase=='dip':
  move([-.10,.153,.10]);move([-.10,.153,.026],speed=.02,hold=1);move([-.10,.153,.08])
  move([-.05,-.18,.06],angle=25)
  o=obs();o.save('/app/output/after_dip')
  for c,im in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT/f'{c}.png')
 elif phase=='practice':
  move([-.05,-.18,.024],angle=25,speed=.015)
  move([-.05,-.18,.0193],angle=25,speed=.003)
  line([[-.05,-.18],[-.075,-.18]],angle=25)
  move([-.075,-.18,.04],angle=25,speed=.01)
  move([-.1,.15,.08],angle=25)
  o=obs();o.save('/app/output/practice1')
  for c,im in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT/f'{c}.png')

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw

from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter
from scipy.optimize import minimize
import json,time
from pathlib import Path
O=Path('/app/output')
# Each list describes a single natural pen pass. Coordinates from the exemplar.
paths=[
 [[334,489],[313,486],[295,500],[286,522],[291,544],[307,555],[325,556],[343,547]],
 [[293,451],[316,444],[336,453],[349,478],[352,511],[350,540],[345,558]],
 [[413,486],[392,491],[380,505],[379,529],[391,549],[410,556],[436,554],[453,538],[457,517],[449,499],[434,487],[413,486]],
 [[479,490],[487,486],[487,518],[487,557]],
 [[487,484],[502,506],[518,530],[534,555]],
 [[534,483],[534,514],[534,554]],
 [[564,490],[573,485],[573,516],[577,541],[590,554],[607,555],[617,543],[622,526]],
 [[622,484],[622,515],[622,545],[623,557],[631,554]],
 [[658,558],[653,535],[655,511],[665,494],[680,485],[691,491],[696,513],[696,536],[696,558]],
 [[700,495],[716,485],[728,490],[735,507],[736,527],[732,544],[724,558]]
]
# Key point interpolation maintains a compact smooth stroke, never a fill.
origin=np.array([270,430]); sz=(480,140)
im=np.array(Image.open('/app/target.png'))[430:570,270:750,0]
target=(248-im.astype(float))/(248-19);target=np.clip(target,0,1)
S=3
angle=25; width=4/.22186; thickness=.4/.22186
vec=np.array([np.cos(np.deg2rad(angle)),-np.sin(np.deg2rad(angle))])*width/2

def sample(p,n=180):
 p=np.asarray(p);t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p,axis=0),axis=1))];t=t/t[-1]
 return CubicSpline(t,p,axis=0)(np.linspace(0,1,n))
def render(ps,crop=None,ss=S):
 if crop is None: crop=(0,0,480,140)
 x,y,w,h=crop
 out=Image.new('L',(w*ss,h*ss));d=ImageDraw.Draw(out)
 for p in ps:
  a=(sample(p)-origin-[x,y])*ss;e=vec*ss
  left=a+e;right=a-e
  for k in range(len(a)-1):
   d.polygon([tuple(left[k]),tuple(left[k+1]),tuple(right[k+1]),tuple(right[k])],fill=255)
  # rectangle thickness comes from a narrow perpendicular nib dimension
  thick=max(1,round(thickness*ss))
  d.line([tuple(z) for z in left],fill=255,width=thick,joint='curve')
  d.line([tuple(z) for z in right],fill=255,width=thick,joint='curve')
  d.line([tuple(left[0]),tuple(right[0])],fill=255,width=thick)
  d.line([tuple(left[-1]),tuple(right[-1])],fill=255,width=thick)
 return np.array(out.resize((w,h),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS))/255

def output(ps,name):
 pred=render(ps)
 inter=np.minimum(target,pred).sum();union=np.maximum(target,pred).sum();print(name,'softiou',inter/union,flush=True)
 rgb=np.zeros((*target.shape,3),np.uint8)+248
 rgb[target>.5]=[190,55,55];rgb[pred>.5]=[50,90,210];rgb[(target>.5)&(pred>.5)]=[19,18,20]
 # annotate path centers
 out=Image.fromarray(rgb).resize((1440,420));out.save(O/(name+'.png'))
 json.dump([np.asarray(p).tolist() for p in ps],open(O/(name+'.json'),'w'))

if __name__=='__main__':
 import sys
 if len(sys.argv)>1: paths=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
 output(paths,'fit_initial')
 groups=[([0,1],(0,0,95,140)),([2],(95,42,105,95)),([3,4,5],(198,42,80,95)),([6,7],(281,42,93,95)),([8,9],(370,42,110,95))]
 for inds,crop in groups:
  x,y,w,h=crop; tgt=target[y:y+h,x:x+w];blur=gaussian_filter(tgt,.6)
  shapes=[np.shape(paths[i]) for i in inds];lens=[np.prod(s) for s in shapes];p0=np.concatenate([np.array(paths[i]).ravel() for i in inds]);ncall=[0]
  def unpack(v):return [a.reshape(s) for a,s in zip(np.split(v,np.cumsum(lens)[:-1]),shapes)]
  def loss(v):
   ps=unpack(v);pred=render(ps,crop);err=((gaussian_filter(pred,.6)-blur)**2).mean()
   # weak regularity prior prevents gratuitous excursions
   err+=.000003*np.mean((v-p0)**2)
   ncall[0]+=1
   return err
  t0=time.time();print('fit',inds,'loss',loss(p0),flush=True)
  opt=minimize(loss,p0,method='Powell',bounds=[(v-7,v+7) for v in p0],options={'maxiter':12,'xtol':.08,'ftol':.00008})
